Maharashtra MLC Sachin Ahir Joins Shinde Faction, Files Council Nomination

Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sachin Ahir has joined the Eknath Shinde faction of the Shiv Sena and filed his nomination for the Maharashtra Legislative Council Deputy Chairman post. This move is described by several outlets as a setback for Uddhav Thackeray's faction. The nomination was confirmed by Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Ambadas Danve.
